verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser's docs claim stealth mode and CAPTCHA-solving to evade bot detection, but there is no documentation of residential or geo-targeted proxy options, and hands-on community reports contradict the anti-detection claims: one user was 'instantly blocked by cloudflare' despite using the service, and another found requests originating from generic Google Cloud IP ranges with spoofed/inconsistent user-agents rather than residential IPs. Missing for 10: explicit residential/geo-targeted proxy documentation, and independent verification that stealth mode reliably avoids bot blocks.
